decisions.reason: As a simple accessory closely tied to the firm's existing trailer and after-sales knowledge, it is easy to sustain, though its low visibility and limited strategic weight raise some rationalization risk.
This box car trailer line remains strongly anchored in the firm's core design, production and service capabilities, so management would usually keep and refine it rather than exit it.
The low-bed trailer series fits the firm's established hauling know-how and customer base well, giving management enough related knowledge to continue improving it commercially.
The high trailer cover series builds on existing trailer platforms and accessory channels, so the firm can absorb market feedback and maintain it, even if demand may be somewhat more niche.

Although technically close to the firm's knowledge base, a second box car trailer series creates overlap, and after several years of learning management would likely concentrate resources on the stronger core series and new developments.
